products.name: Golden Bullet 380 — Single Pack (1 Tablet)
description: Golden Bullet 380 is supplied as a single chewable tablet in a sealed, tamper-evident pack. The pack carries the full ingredient list, dosage and directions, warnings, storage instructions, batch number, expiry date and regulator registration number.

This single tablet pack is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Read the pack and the safety information page before use, and speak to a healthcare professional if you take any medication or have a medical condition.

posts.title: Understanding Erectile Dysfunction: When to Talk to a Doctor
posts.excerpt: Erectile difficulties are common and often have a physical cause. Here is what a clinician will want to know, and why self-treatment can be risky.

body.text: This article is general education. It is not medical advice and it does not describe what any supplement can do. If you are experiencing erectile difficulties, speak to a doctor or pharmacist.
It is more common than most men think

Occasional difficulty is common and is often linked to stress, tiredness, alcohol, or a temporary change in circumstances. Difficulty that continues over weeks or months is worth investigating, because it can be an early sign of a condition that needs treatment, such as cardiovascular disease or diabetes.
What a clinician will ask

items: When the difficulty started, and whether it is occasional or consistent.
Any medication you take, including blood pressure medicines, antidepressants and hair-loss treatments.
Your cardiovascular history, including chest pain, palpitations and blood pressure readings.
Lifestyle factors such as sleep, alcohol, smoking and physical activity.
Whether morning erections have changed.

body.text: Why self-treatment can be risky

Some prescription treatments for erectile dysfunction interact dangerously with nitrate medication and with medicines used for chest pain. Buying treatment without a consultation can mean missing that interaction, or missing a diagnosis that needs attention.
Never take a medicine for erectile dysfunction together with nitrate medication. If you have chest pain, seek urgent medical care.
Where supplements fit

Supplements are not medicines. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease, and they are not a substitute for a clinical assessment. If you choose to use one alongside your normal care, show the label to your pharmacist or doctor so they can check it against your medication.

posts.title: How to Read a Supplement Label Before You Buy
posts.excerpt: Ingredient list, dosage, warnings, storage, batch number, expiry date and a registration number. Use this checklist before any purchase.

body.text: A complete label is the most useful thing on any supplement pack. If a seller cannot show you one before you buy, that is a reason to pause.
The label checklist

items: Full ingredient list, including excipients, with amounts where required.
Dosage and directions, including the maximum amount in 24 hours.
Warnings and contraindications, including medicines and conditions that rule out use.
Storage instructions and the shelf life after opening.
Batch or lot number and expiry date, printed on the pack itself.
The regulator registration number and the name and address of the manufacturer or distributor.

body.text: Questions worth asking

items: Does the seller publish the full ingredient list before checkout?
Is there a documented batch number that can be traced to a manufacturing record?
Are the warnings specific, or is the label vague about who should not use it?
Is the product advertised with promises that no supplement is allowed to make?

body.text: Red flags
Treat claims that a supplement cures or treats a disease, works for everyone, or has no possible side effects as a warning sign. Supplements are not medicines and cannot make those claims.

posts.title: Discreet Delivery and Payment: What to Expect
posts.excerpt: How orders are packed, what appears on a statement, and which payment methods are accepted.

body.text: Discretion is a design decision, not a promise we make about other people. Here is exactly what happens to an order after checkout.
Packaging
Orders leave our warehouse in plain outer packaging with no product names, no imagery and no indication of the contents. The only label on the outside is the delivery label required by the courier.
On your statement
Card payments are processed by our payment provider and appear under the trading name shown at checkout. If you need the exact descriptor before ordering, contact support and we will confirm it.
Payment methods

items: Visa
Mastercard
Verve
Paystack
Bank transfer where available

body.text: Age verification
This store is for adults aged 18 and over. Orders require confirmation that the buyer is 18 or older, and delivery companies may ask for identification on delivery.
